Container.Name: GamePanel
Container.Overview: Game server control panel: one web page to install, run, back up and mod game servers. This template runs the panel in host network mode and starts each game server as a sibling container through the Docker socket (mounted below). Mounting the Docker socket gives the panel control of Docker on this Unraid server: only give panel admin accounts to people you trust. The data folder is mapped to the same path inside and outside the container on purpose.
Container.Requires: Docker must be running. The first start of a game downloads its files, so give the share some room.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the panel listens on (host network mode).

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Servers, backups and settings. The container path must equal the host path, so game containers can mount their folders.

Config.Name: Data folder path inside the panel
Config.Description: Leave equal to the data folder above.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets the panel start game servers as containers. Gives it control of Docker.
